gen-dafont-visitor-fs-plein: Pixel-era grit, gaping e mouths and marker-steady lines up top. Plein follows with a clear channel into each round letter, so body text can go modestly sized without clogging.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-roundo: Retro screen chunkiness, all short ascenders and big bowls. Roundo brings a moderate lowercase and open little counters, so Visitor shouts the headline while the sans text underneath keeps quietly to its work.
gen-dafont-visitor-fs-spline-sans: Spline Sans keeps wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Beside Visitor's chunky, solder-pulled display strokes, that approachable plain sans makes the heading's nostalgic digital grit stand out sharply.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-almendra: Visitor draws smooth, plotter-like strokes with gaping e mouths and short ascenders over big bowls, a nostalgic digital look. Almendra's deep-bodied lowercase does the dignified, bookish reading.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-bree-serif: Bree Serif reads literary and refined, its lowercase oddly outsized and generous. Visitor, the heading, runs parallel stroke edges through every curve, giving a nostalgic digital contrast to that text serif.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-port-lligat-slab: Strokes with no stress in the curves, pulled like solder, give Visitor its nostalgic digital stamp. Port Lligat Slab brings wide porthole counters and open curves, so the serif text can sit at a modest size.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-quando: Visitor's bowls are as heavy as its stems, with gaping e mouths and short ascenders. Quando counters with sparse, widely spaced letters and a tall middle zone, giving a bookish, traditional classic serif feel over long paragraphs.
gen-dafont-visitor-outfit: Outfit draws curves that stop well before they close, like bent cable, with no swelling or thinning. Outfit sits beneath Visitor's nostalgic, gaping-mouthed display letters as an approachable plain sans, taller headline above, moderate lowercase below.
gen-dafont-visitor-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is modern and precise, monoline throughout. Plus Jakarta Sans sits under Visitor's nostalgic, solder-pulled display letters, its curve endings kept well apart against that tall, chunky lowercase.
gen-dafont-visitor-sora: Precise and geometric, Sora turns its corners with no pressure swell. Sora keeps its c and s widely parted below Visitor's nostalgic, gaping-mouthed display letters, which stand taller and chunkier on the page.
